commands.name: model
commands.description: Manage GGUF models from HuggingFace Hub.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum number of results.

options.name: --sort
options.description: Sort field: downloads, likes, lastModified.

commands.name: pull

options.name: --dir
options.description:
Destination directory. Defaults to
~/.dotllm/models/.

options.name: --file
options.description:
Specific GGUF filename to download. If omitted, lists
available files for selection.

commands.description: Download a GGUF model from HuggingFace.

commands.name: info
commands.description:
Show details for a HuggingFace model 
repository.

options.name: --quant
options.description:
Quantization filter (e.g. Q4_K_M, Q8_0). Narrows match
when repo has multiple files.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation prompt.

arguments.name: model
arguments.description:
HuggingFace repo ID (e.g. 
'Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF') or filename pattern.

commands.name: run

options.name: --cache-type-k
options.description:
KV-cache key quantization: f32 (default), q8_0,
q4_0.

options.name: --cache-type-v
options.description:
KV-cache value quantization: f32 (default), q8_0,
q4_0.

options.name: --cache-window
options.description:
Mixed-precision window: recent N tokens in full precision
(0 = all quantized). Only used when --cache-type-k or --cache-type-v is
set.

options.name: --decode-threads
options.description:
Number of threads for decode. 0 = auto (caps at memory
channel count).

options.name: --device
options.description:
Compute device: 'cpu' (default), 'gpu', 'gpu:0',
'gpu:1'.

options.name: --gpu-layers
options.description:
Number of transformer layers to offload to GPU. 0 = CPU
only. Omit for default (0 with --device cpu, all with --device
gpu).

options.name: --grammar
options.description:
GBNF grammar string or file path (prefixed with @) for
grammar response format.

options.name: --json
options.description:
Output result as a single JSON object (suppresses all
formatted output).

options.name: --max-tokens
options.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

options.name: --min-p
options.description: Min-P sampling threshold. 0 = disabled.

options.name: --numa-pin
options.description:
Pin workers to NUMA-local cores on multi-socket
systems.

options.name: --paged
options.description:
Use paged KV-cache with block-based allocation instead of
pre-allocated simple cache.

options.name: --pattern
options.description:
Regex pattern for regex response format. Entire output must
match.

options.name: --pcore-only
options.description:
Pin workers to P-cores only (Intel hybrid
architectures).

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Input prompt for generation (required).

options.name: --quant
options.description:
Quantization filter when multiple GGUF files exist (e.g.,
Q4_K_M, Q8_0).

options.name: --repeat-last-n
options.description:
Number of recent tokens for repetition penalty lookback. 0
= full history.

options.name: --repeat-penalty
options.description: Repetition penalty factor. 1.0 = disabled.

options.name: --response-format
options.description:
Constrain model output format: 'text' (default),
'json_object', 'json_schema', 'regex', or 'grammar'.

options.name: --schema
options.description:
JSON Schema string or file path (prefixed with @) for
json_schema response format.

options.name: --seed
options.description:
Random seed for reproducible sampling. Omit for
non-deterministic.

options.name: --speculative-k
options.description:
Number of draft tokens per speculative step (K). Default
5.

options.name: --speculative-model
options.description:
Path or HuggingFace repo ID for a draft model. Enables
speculative decoding for faster generation. Must share vocabulary with the main
model.

options.name: --temp
options.description: Sampling temperature. 0 = greedy (default).

options.name: --threads
options.description:
Number of CPU threads for inference. 0 = auto/all cores
(default), 1 = single-threaded.

options.name: --tools
options.description:
Tool definitions: JSON array string or file path (prefixed
with @). When provided, the prompt is formatted via the model's chat template
with tool definitions.

options.name: --top-k
options.description: Top-K sampling. 0 = disabled.

options.name: --top-p
options.description: Top-P (nucleus) sampling threshold.

arguments.name: model
arguments.description:
Path to a GGUF file or HuggingFace repo ID (e.g., 
QuantFactory/SmolLM-135M-GGUF).

commands.description: Run greedy text generation on a GGUF model.
examples: run QuantFactory/SmolLM-135M-GGUF --prompt The capital of France is --max-tokens 64

commands.name: serve

options.name: --cache-type-k
options.description:
KV-cache key quantization: f32 (default), q8_0,
q4_0.

options.description:

q4_0.

options.name: --device

Number of transformer layers to offload to

options.description: Host address to bind to.

options.description: Don't auto-open the browser.

options.name: --no-paged
options.description:
Disable paged KV-cache. When enabled (default), uses
block-based allocation for memory efficiency.

options.description:
Disable prompt caching. When enabled (default), KV-cache
state is reused across turns.

options.name: --no-ui
options.description:
Disable the built-in web chat UI. Only serve API
endpoints.

options.name: --no-warmup
options.description:
Disable warm-up passes at startup. When enabled (default),
dummy inference runs trigger JIT compilation.

options.name: --port
options.description: Port to listen on.

options.description:
Maximum number of cached sessions for prompt
caching.

Quantization filter when multiple GGUF files exist (e.g.,
Q4_K_M, Q8_0).

Number of draft tokens per speculative step (K). Default
5.

options.name: --speculative-model
options.description:
Path or HuggingFace repo ID for a draft model. Enables
speculative decoding for faster generation. Must share vocabulary with the main
model.

options.name: --threads
options.description:
Number of CPU threads for inference. 0 =
auto.

options.name: --warmup-iterations
options.description:
Number of warm-up iterations (default: 3). More iterations
improve JIT optimization via Dynamic PGO.

Path to a GGUF file or HuggingFace repo ID. Omit to start 
without a model (load from UI).
